description: The Congress party's AI-generated video featuring Prime Minister Modi and his late mother has ignited a political controversy, prompting outrage from the BJP.
body_lead: The Patna High Court on 17 September directed the Congress party to take down the AI-generated video of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s mother from all social media platforms. The order was pronounced by acting Chief Justice PB Bajantari. The Court directed the intermediaries to stall the circulation of the video, if it is still being circulated, in the light of the various Supreme Court judgments such as "KS Puttaswamy", "NALSA Foundation", "Subramanian Swamy" etc, which held that the right to privacy and dignity were part of fundamental rights of a person, legal news website LiveLaw said.
